profile: Release opt-level=3, Thin LTO, overflow checks enabled; repository defaults
scope: Shared x86_64 timing host; AArch64 disassembly and QEMU execution are not physical iPad timing. One shipping interpreter, no JIT.
decision: Do not promote any candidate. Runtime code is restored to base_commit; retain two semantic regression tests, archived patches and measurements. Table-only results are mixed and noisy, not proof of a universal speedup or a physical ARM64 regression.
incremental_baseline_repeat: Two successive no-change Cargo invocations retained the same baseline hash. This is not a clean-build reproducibility test.

variants.baseline: Unchanged runtime at base_commit, newly preserved before edits.
variants.special: Constant tail-handler table plus 14 ordinary-GPR, W/X operand forms.
variants.resident: special plus four scalar tail arguments for guest x0-x3, retained across decoded instructions; publication/reload around reference paths and every exit.
variants.table: Constant tail-handler table only, original 26 operation classes. Same 32-byte instruction and 40-byte generation entry.

patch_validation: All three patches independently pass git apply --check --cached against base_commit.
